scenario: An issue asks the agent to keep Nayax's own machine-stock figures 'in sync' after an operator reconciles a Sync Restock event into local storage inventory. The agent's design calls the Nayax Lynx API to push the corrected stock level back to the machine record in Nayax.
policyReferences: docs/architecture.md § Nayax machine-stock event import and Sync Restock reconciliation
expectedBehavior: Nayax remains authoritative for the physical stock-adjustment fact and is never written to for InventoryApp's storage-stock adjustments; InventoryApp only imports the fact and manages storage inventory, costing, and reporting locally.
forbiddenOutcomes: Calling a Nayax API to write back a stock level, quantity, or adjustment derived from InventoryApp's local reconciliation.
Treating Nayax as the system of record for InventoryApp-side storage-stock corrections.

assertions.text: responsible for storage inventory, costing, restock planning, and reporting. The workflow never
writes machine stock back to Nayax, and it never treats Nayax `PAR` as guaranteed physical slot
